about_the_game:
THE PRIMALS Live in Japan - Beyond the Shadow is now available!

This album features 21 tracks performed by THE PRIMALS, showcasing popular songs and live staples from FINAL FANTASY XIV: A Realm Reborn to the expansion pack Endwalker, all delivered with their signature powerful rock sound.

*The tracklist differs from the Blu-ray version.

*This is an audio-only album and does not include video content.
